_purpose: LNES-59.2B frozen retry policy (comparator spec section 16). Applies identically to all 8 arms. A semantically wrong answer is NEVER retryable -- retries exist only for infrastructure/model-execution failure.
empty_completion_behavior: retry with the identical prompt, up to max_retries
malformed_json_behavior: retry with the identical prompt (no reformatting/coaching added), up to max_retries
truncation_behavior: retry once with an increased max_tokens ceiling; if still truncated after retries exhausted, record as error_state=truncated_after_retries and exclude from accuracy metrics (report separately as an infrastructure failure, not a wrong answer)
_retries_count_toward_latency_metrics_no: Per-case latency metrics report the FINAL successful attempt's own latency, not the cumulative retry latency -- retry overhead is tracked separately as retry_count and retry_latency_seconds so it doesn't distort the arm's core latency comparison, but is still fully preserved in the raw output record.
after_retries_exhausted: record error_state (empty_completion_after_retries | malformed_json_after_retries | truncated_after_retries | timeout_after_retries), no further attempts, case-arm evaluation marked as an infrastructure failure not a correctness failure
